title: Sensitivity-Guided Selection Hyper-Heuristic for the Thermo-Hydraulic Design of a Hybrid-Nanofluid Evacuated-Tube Collector (reproducibility package)

creators.name: Khan, Muhammed Anaz
creators.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, College of Engineering, University of Bisha, Bisha 61922, P.O. Box 551, Saudi Arabia

description: Reproducibility package for the study of a computational, surrogate-assisted selection hyper-heuristic (upper-confidence-bound credit assignment with late-acceptance hill-climbing over a twelve-operator portfolio) applied to the constrained thermo-hydraulic design of a closed-loop hybrid-nanofluid evacuated-tube solar collector. Includes the full-factorial dataset, the reconstructed reduced-order simulator, the trained pure-NumPy gradient-boosted-tree surrogates, the hyper-heuristic and baseline (differential evolution, CMA-ES, random-selection ablation) implementations, the from-first-principles statistical tests (Friedman, Nemenyi critical difference, Holm-corrected Wilcoxon), and every derived result, table and figure. Source code is MIT-licensed; the dataset, trained models, figures and derived results are released under CC BY 4.0. See REPRODUCIBILITY.md for the pinned numerical environment and the scope of bit-exact reproduction.
